blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The decision of six senator-judges to abstain from voting on the conviction threshold for Vice President Sara Duterte does not reflect how they will rule on her ultimate guilt or innocence, prosecution leaders said Thursday. During a press conference, lead prosecutor and Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro clarified that a senator’s stance on procedural matters differs from their vote on the final verdict. “I believe that the position of the senator-judges depends on the question confronting them,” Luistro said. “Their position on the threshold vote does not necessarily show their position on the verdict.” READ: Consistent, Luistro says […]...
